descriptions.d24l_choice_icon_802a62bc: Updates the current choice icon: splits the lines if not done (+596), retints when the index +600 reached the count +580, computes a scale from the data vector's y times 1.1875 and an x offset, detaches and releases the old icon +236, loads the icon named at +420[index] (or 'FE.I.Padlock' when +240 is set) with type byte(+35)+32 through 0x802b1510, reports a missing resource into +108, otherwise attaches, scales and positions it.
